errors.evidence: The intervals on the x-axis represent months, indicated by Roman numerals I through XII for each year, not quarterly periods.
The sharp drop to approximately 78.0 occurs in December (XII) 2023, not December 2024. In December 2024, the value is a peak around 106.0.
The chart data ends in April (IV) 2025. There is no data point for August (VIII) 2025.
